signals.title: Claude Code restores dropped remote MCP connections in non-interactive and SDK sessions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 为非交互与 SDK 会话恢复掉线的远程 MCP 连接
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.243 reports that remote MCP servers in non-interactive and SDK sessions now reconnect automatically after dropped connections or surface an explicit failure instead of remaining permanently unavailable.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.243 明确说明：非交互与 SDK 会话中的远程 MCP Server 在连接中断后会自动重连，或者明确报告失败，不再永久停留在不可用状态。

signals.title: Claude Code fixes mid-turn cloud-session resume so pending notifications do not become the resumed prompt
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 修复云会话中途恢复，避免 Pending Notification 被误当作恢复 Prompt
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.243 fixes cloud sessions resumed after a mid-turn restart so a pending hook or background-task notification is not resent as the user prompt and the session resumes with the normal continuation message.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.243 修复了云会话在 Turn 中途重启后的恢复语义：Pending Hook 或后台任务通知不再被重新发送成用户 Prompt，而是按正常 Continuation Message 继续。

signals.title: Claude Code wakes background subagents when their final background Bash task completes
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在最后一个后台 Bash 任务完成时唤醒后台 Subagent
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.243 fixes a liveness gap where background subagents could remain asleep after their last background Bash task completed; completion now provides a wake transition.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.243 修复了后台 Subagent 在最后一个后台 Bash 任务完成后仍可能沉睡的活性缺口；任务完成现在会形成明确的唤醒转换。

signals.title: Codex adds typed persisted thread artifacts with per-thread identity and ordered reads
signals.title_zh: Codex 增加带线程内身份与有序读取的 Typed Persisted Thread Artifacts
signals.summary: Codex adds a thread_artifacts SQLite table with typed identities scoped to a thread, JSON payloads, cascade deletion, uniqueness enforcement and an index for ordered per-thread reads, plus exported attach/remove/pagination models.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 新增 thread_artifacts SQLite 表：Artifact 具有线程内 Typed Identity、JSON Payload、Cascade Delete、唯一性约束和线程内有序读取索引，并导出 Attach/Remove/Pagination 模型。

signals.title: Codex persists realtime conversation events in a canonical paginated thread timeline
signals.title_zh: Codex 将实时会话事件持久化进规范化、可分页的 Thread Timeline
signals.summary: Codex persists realtime session boundaries, transcript segments, promoted agent items and turn lifecycle events into paginated rollouts, adds thread/timeline/list and emits typed realtime item lifecycle notifications while preserving legacy history APIs.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将 Realtime Session Boundary、Transcript Segment、Promoted Agent Item 与 Turn Lifecycle Event 持久化到分页 Rollout，新增 thread/timeline/list 与 Typed Realtime Item 生命周期通知，同时保持旧 History API 不变。

signals.title: Codex makes startup rollout migration recover from concurrent writes, archive moves and maintenance contention
signals.title_zh: Codex 让启动期 Rollout Migration 可从并发写入、归档移动与维护竞争中恢复
signals.summary: Codex waits for rollout maintenance, re-reads newly empty rollouts under their writer lock, retries busy rollouts on later startups and rediscovers archived or compressed paths that move after discovery, while terminal failures do not block the startup cursor.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 在迁移前等待 Rollout Maintenance，针对刚变为空的 Rollout 在 Writer Lock 下重读，把 Busy Rollout 留到后续启动重试，并重新发现 Discovery 后被归档或压缩而移动的路径，同时让永久失败不阻塞 Startup Cursor。

signals.title: Codex isolates internal Guardian reviews from parent-session customization while retaining managed restrictions
signals.title_zh: Codex 隔离内部 Guardian Review 与父会话自定义状态，同时保留 Managed Restriction
signals.summary: Codex starts internal and subagent Guardian reviews without inherited user instructions, extensions, MCP servers or multi-agent behavior while preserving managed execution policy, selected environment constraints and only the allowed review tools.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 的内部与 Subagent Guardian Review 不再继承用户 Instructions、Extensions、MCP Servers 或多 Agent 行为，但继续保留 Managed Execution Policy、选定环境限制，并仅暴露允许的 Review Tools。

signals.title: Codex prevents project configuration from influencing credential-provider and shell startup state during brokering
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Credential Brokering 启用时阻止项目配置影响凭据 Provider 与 Shell 启动状态
signals.summary: When credential brokering is active, Codex ignores project-layer settings that could affect shell snapshots, profile loading, ZDOTDIR, BASH_ENV or credential-provider environment variables, while preserving those settings when brokering is effectively disabled.
signals.summary_zh: Credential Brokering 生效时，Codex 忽略可能影响 Shell Snapshot、Profile Loading、ZDOTDIR、BASH_ENV 或凭据 Provider 环境变量的项目层设置；当 Brokering 实际关闭时则保留这些项目设置。

signals.title: Codex propagates root turn IDs through turn and tool analytics for subagent attribution
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Turn 与 Tool Analytics 中传播 Root Turn ID 以归因 Subagent 活动
signals.summary: Codex adds root_turn_id to turn and tool-item analytics, reads it from live turn metadata and propagates it through control-tool and code-mode completion facts so subagent and background activity can be correlated to the originating top-level turn; ambiguous roots are reported as null.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为 Turn 与 Tool-Item Analytics 增加 root_turn_id，并从实时 Turn Metadata 读取、经 Control Tool 与 Code Mode Completion Fact 传播，使 Subagent 与后台活动可关联至顶层发起 Turn；来源歧义时明确记录为 null。

signals.title: Codex bounds skills.read pages to each tool-call response budget and snapshots cursor continuations
signals.title_zh: Codex 按每次 Tool Call 的响应预算约束 skills.read 分页并快照 Cursor Continuation
signals.summary: Codex sizes each serialized skills.read page to the active response budget with JSON escaping and UTF-8 boundaries accounted for, and caches one bounded resource snapshot per thread so cursor continuations remain consistent without rereading mutable files.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 按当前 Response Budget 计算每个 skills.read 序列化页面，同时考虑 JSON Escaping 与 UTF-8 边界；并为每个 Thread 缓存一个有界 Resource Snapshot，使 Cursor Continuation 在不重新读取可变文件的情况下保持一致。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK adds trusted, configurable host-environment isolation for Unix-local sandboxes
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 为 Unix-Local Sandbox 增加受信任、可配置的 Host Environment 隔离
signals.summary: UnixLocalSandboxClient can disable full host-environment inheritance and use a default or custom allowlist. The inheritance policy remains under trusted runtime-client control across resume and is deliberately not serialized into untrusted session state.
signals.summary_zh: UnixLocalSandboxClient 现在可以关闭完整 Host Environment 继承，并使用默认或自定义 Allowlist。该继承策略在 Resume 前后始终由受信任 Runtime Client 控制，并刻意不序列化进可恢复 Session State。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK reconciles uncertain resumed Session writes before any new model call
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在新 Model Call 前对不确定的 Resumed Session Write 进行对账
signals.summary: The Agents SDK persists a pending resumed Session append in RunState, fingerprints authoritative history and settles whether the batch committed before the next model call. Changed or ambiguous history fails closed and requires repair instead of rerunning already completed tool work.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 将待确认的 Resumed Session Append 持久化进 RunState，通过权威 History 指纹判断该批次是否已经提交，并在下一次 Model Call 前完成对账；History 已变化或存在歧义时 Fail Closed，要求修复而不是重跑已经完成的 Tool Work。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK applies server-wide input and output guardrails to every MCP tool
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 将 Server-Wide Input/Output Guardrail 应用于每个 MCP Tool
signals.summary: MCP server constructors can now define server-wide tool input and output guardrails; each converted FunctionTool receives isolated copies of those guardrail lists across stdio, SSE and Streamable HTTP, with regression coverage for approval and serialized-resume ordering.
signals.summary_zh: MCP Server Constructor 现在可定义 Server-Wide Tool Input/Output Guardrail；通过 stdio、SSE 与 Streamable HTTP 转换出的每个 FunctionTool 都获得独立 Guardrail List 副本，并新增 Approval 与 Serialized Resume 顺序回归测试。

signals.title: Gemini CLI rolls back cancelled tool turns and bounds automatic recovery from empty post-tool responses
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 回滚被取消的 Tool Turn，并对 Tool 后空响应的自动恢复设置有界次数
signals.summary: Gemini CLI now rolls model-issued tool-call history back to the post-user-prompt boundary when all tool calls are cancelled rather than appending synthetic cancellation responses. When a successful tool continuation returns no visible model text, it auto-nudges the model with a bounded maximum of two attempts.
signals.summary_zh: 当一个 Turn 的 Tool Call 全部被取消时，Gemini CLI 现在把 Model-issued Tool Call History 回滚到 User Prompt 之后的边界，而不是追加合成 Cancellation Response；成功 Tool Continuation 若没有可见模型文本，则最多自动 Nudge 两次。

signals.title: Gemini CLI declares allowed-path safety checkers as top-level write-policy controls
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 将 Allowed-Path Safety Checker 声明为顶层 Write Policy 控制
signals.summary: Gemini CLI moves allowed-path safety checkers for replace and write_file into explicit top-level safety_checker declarations with tool name, priority and mode, and adds tests proving both controls load from the default write policy.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 将 replace 与 write_file 的 Allowed-Path Safety Checker 改为显式顶层 safety_checker 声明，包含 Tool Name、Priority 与 Mode，并新增测试确认默认 Write Policy 中两项控制均能被加载。

signals.title: Gemini CLI clears stale A2A cancellation errors before new message turns
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在新的 A2A Message Turn 前清理陈旧 Cancellation Error
signals.summary: Gemini CLI's A2A server clears a stale cancellation error when beginning a new message turn so a prior cancelled turn cannot poison the state of the next independent turn.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 的 A2A Server 在开始新的 Message Turn 时清理上一 Turn 遗留的 Cancellation Error，避免前一个取消状态污染下一次独立 Turn。

signals.title: MCP Python SDK gives recursive tool return types an object-rooted output schema
signals.title_zh: MCP Python SDK 为递归 Tool Return Type 生成 Object-Rooted Output Schema
signals.summary: The MCP Python SDK changes schema generation so recursive tool return types retain an object-rooted output schema, tightening the machine-readable contract exposed for recursive structured results.
signals.summary_zh: MCP Python SDK 调整 Schema 生成，使递归 Tool Return Type 仍保持 Object-Rooted Output Schema，从而收紧递归结构化结果对外暴露的机器可读契约。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves required parameters in CrewAI and LangChain function declarations
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 CrewAI 与 LangChain Function Declaration 中保留 Required Parameter
signals.summary: Google ADK fixes CrewAI and LangChain function declaration conversion to include the required list, preserving mandatory-argument semantics when tool schemas cross framework boundaries.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 修复 CrewAI 与 LangChain 的 Function Declaration 转换，使其携带 required 列表，在 Tool Schema 跨框架边界时保留必填参数语义。
